mapper.select: SELECT t.SHPOUT_DT AS shpoutDt, t.DLV_DT AS dlvDt, t.JOB_SEQ AS jobSeq, t.ROW_NO AS rowNo, t.SRC_FILE AS srcFile, CONVERT(varchar(19), t.UPLOAD_DTTM, 120) AS uploadDttm, -- ★firstDttm(같은 품목 최초 업로드일시) — 종전에는 행마다 상관 서브쿼리로 같은 테이블을 다시 뒤졌다. -- 4,562행 조회에서 이 한 칸이 871ms 를 먹었다(944ms → 73ms, 2026-07-25 실측). -- 윈도우 함수로 한 번에 계산한다(=167ms). 파티션 범위는 종전과 동일 — 기간·ACTION_YN 과 무관하게 -- 같은 (출고일자+출고장+사업장+품목)의 전체 최소값이라 아래 t 서브쿼리 안에서 먼저 계산해야 한다. t.firstDttm, t.DC_CD AS dcCd, t.DC_NM AS dcNm, t.VENDOR_CD AS vendorCd, t.VENDOR_NM AS vendorNm, t.ITEM_CD AS itemCd, t.ITEM_NM AS itemNm, t.BIZ_CD AS bizCd, t.BIZ_NM AS bizNm, t.BOX_QTY AS boxQty, t.LABEL_QTY AS labelQty, t.UNPAID_LABEL_QTY AS unpaidLabelQty, t.INWH AS inwh, t.ZONE AS zone, t.BUS_NO AS busNo, t.RT_SEQ AS rtSeq, t.CUR_QTY AS curQty, t.DLV_GB AS dlvGb, t.REMARK AS remark, t.PROD_KIND AS prodKind, t.TEMP_GB AS tempGb, t.ORD_GB AS ordGb, t.UNIT AS unit, t.ORD_NO AS ordNo, t.ORD_ITEM_NO AS ordItemNo, t.JUMUN_NO AS jumunNo, t.JUMUN_ITEM_NO AS jumunItemNo, -- ★판매단가 — 마감관리(selectClosing)와 똑같은 규칙(2026-07-25). 매출내역에서 정산서가 아직 안 온 -- 출고행의 매출금액을 이 단가로 채운다. 기준일은 마감과 같이 납품일자(DLV_DT). u.saleUnit, u.saleSrc FROM ( SELECT s0.*, CONVERT(varchar(19), MIN(s0.UPLOAD_DTTM) OVER (PARTITION BY s0.SHPOUT_DT, ISNULL(s0.DC_CD,''), ISNULL(s0.BIZ_CD,''), ISNULL(s0.ITEM_CD,'')), 120) AS firstDttm FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s0 ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.PROD_CD, p.SALE_PRICE FROM TBL_PROD_MST p WHERE p.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND p.PROD_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(p2.PROD_SEQ) FROM TBL_PROD_MST p2 WHERE p2.PROD_CD = p.PROD_CD AND p2.ACTION_YN = 'Y') ) pm ON pm.PROD_CD = t.ITEM_CD OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 h.SALE_PRICE FROM TBL_PROD_SALEPRICE_HST h WHERE h.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND h.PROD_CD = t.ITEM_CD AND h.APPLY_DT <= t.DLV_DT AND h.VENDOR_CD IS NULL -- 공통가만 (마감과 동일 — 판매처 전용가는 섞지 않는다) ORDER BY h.APPLY_DT DESC, h.SALEPRICE_SEQ DESC ) sh CROSS APPLY ( SELECT ISNULL(sh.SALE_PRICE, ISNULL(pm.SALE_PRICE,0)) AS saleUnit, CASE WHEN sh.SALE_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN '이력' ELSE '마스터' END AS saleSrc ) u WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND t.SHPOUT_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) OR ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND t.SHPOUT_DT = REPLACE(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) OR ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' ) ) ORDER BY t.SHPOUT_DT DESC, t.BIZ_NM, t.ITEM_NM, t.ROW_NO

mapper.select: SELECT sl.dlvKey AS dlvDt, sl.dcKey AS dcCd, MAX(sl.dcNm) AS dcNm, sl.itemCd AS itemCd, MAX(sl.itemNm) AS itemNm, SUM(sl.outQty) AS settleQty, SUM(sl.saleAmt) AS salesAmt FROM ( SELECT REPLACE(ISNULL(m.DLV_DT,''),'-','') AS dlvKey, CASE WHEN ISNULL(m.DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(m.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(m.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(m.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(m.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(m.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(m.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(m.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END AS dcKey, ISNULL(m.ITEM_CD,'') AS itemCd, m.ITEM_NM AS itemNm, m.DC_NM AS dcNm, ISNULL(m.OUT_QTY,0) AS outQty, ISNULL(m.SALE_AMT,0) AS saleAmt FROM TBL_SALES_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' ) sl LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(ISNULL(s.DLV_DT,''),'-','') AS dlvKey, CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END AS dcKey, ISNULL(s.ITEM_CD,'') AS itemCd FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' ) k ON k.dlvKey = sl.dlvKey AND k.dcKey = sl.dcKey AND k.itemCd = sl.itemCd WHERE sl.dlvKey <> '' AND sl.dcKey <> '' AND sl.itemCd <> '' AND ( ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND ISNULL(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND sl.dlvKey BETWEEN REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) OR ( ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR ISNULL(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' ) AND LEFT(sl.dlvKey,6) = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{ym,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','') ) ) /* '짝 없음' = 출고 키 집합에 없음. NOT EXISTS 상관 서브쿼리는 출고장 키가 CASE 식이라 인덱스를 못 타 매번 전체 스캔이 돌았다(3.7초 → 0.05초, 2026-07-25 실측). */ AND k.dlvKey IS NULL GROUP BY sl.dlvKey, sl.dcKey, sl.itemCd ORDER BY SUM(sl.saleAmt) DESC

;WITH B0 AS ( SELECT REPLACE(ISNULL(NULLIF(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''), REPLACE(ISNULL(#{ym,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','')+'01'),'-','') AS fromB, REPLACE(ISNULL(NULLIF(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''), REPLACE(ISNULL(#{ym,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','')+'31'),'-','') AS toB ), B AS ( SELECT fromB, toB, FORMAT(DATEADD(MONTH,-1, CONVERT(date, LEFT(fromB,6)+'01', 112)), 'yyyyMM') AS prevYm FROM B0 ) SELECT t.prodSeq AS prodSeq, t.prodCd AS prodCd, pm.PROD_NM AS prodNm, ISNULL(v.vendorCd,'') AS vendorCd, ISNULL(cs.END_QTY, t.beginQty) AS beginQty, t.inQty AS inQty, t.outQty AS outQty, t.adjQty AS adjQty, (ISNULL(cs.END_QTY, t.beginQty) + t.inQty - t.outQty + t.adjQty) AS endQty, ISNULL(CASE WHEN t.inQtyCum > 0 THEN t.inAmtCum / t.inQtyCum END, ISNULL(cs.AVG_IN_PRICE, ISNULL(pm.IN_PRICE,0))) AS avgInPrice FROM ( SELECT l.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, l.PROD_CD AS prodCd, SUM(CASE WHEN l.TRX_DT < B.fromB THEN (CASE WHEN l.IO_GB IN ('I','R') THEN l.QTY WHEN l.IO_GB='O' THEN -l.QTY WHEN l.IO_GB='A' THEN l.QTY ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS beginQty, SUM(CASE WHEN l.TRX_DT BETWEEN B.fromB AND B.toB AND l.IO_GB IN ('I','R') THEN l.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS inQty, SUM(CASE WHEN l.TRX_DT BETWEEN B.fromB AND B.toB AND l.IO_GB = 'O' THEN l.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS outQty, SUM(CASE WHEN l.TRX_DT BETWEEN B.fromB AND B.toB AND l.IO_GB = 'A' THEN l.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS adjQty, SUM(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB = 'I' THEN l.QTY * ISNULL(l.UNIT_PRICE,0) ELSE 0 END) AS inAmtCum, SUM(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB = 'I' THEN l.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS inQtyCum FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER l CROSS JOIN B WHERE l.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND l.TRX_DT <= B.toB GROUP BY l.PROD_SEQ, l.PROD_CD ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.PROD_CD, p.PROD_NM, p.IN_PRICE FROM TBL_PROD_MST p WHERE p.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND p.PROD_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(p2.PROD_SEQ) FROM TBL_PROD_MST p2 WHERE p2.PROD_CD = p.PROD_CD AND p2.ACTION_YN = 'Y') ) pm ON pm.PROD_CD = t.prodCd LEFT JOIN TBL_CLOSING_STOCK cs ON cs.CLOSE_YM = (SELECT prevYm FROM B) AND cs.PROD_SEQ = t.prodSeq -- 직전 확정월 기말 = 당월 기초 이월 OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 lv.VENDOR_CD AS vendorCd FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER lv CROSS JOIN B WHERE lv.PROD_SEQ = t.prodSeq AND lv.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND lv.IO_GB = 'I' AND lv.TRX_DT BETWEEN B.fromB AND B.toB ORDER BY lv.TRX_DT DESC, lv.LEDGER_SEQ DESC ) v WHERE (t.beginQty <> 0 OR t.inQty <> 0 OR t.outQty <> 0 OR t.adjQty <> 0 OR ISNULL(cs.END_QTY,0) <> 0) ORDER BY t.prodCd

SELECT l.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, l.PROD_CD AS prodCd, MAX(pm.PROD_NM) AS prodNm, ISNULL(l.VENDOR_CD,'') AS vendorCd, SUM(l.QTY) AS inQty, SUM(ISNULL(l.AMT, l.QTY * ISNULL(l.UNIT_PRICE,0))) AS inAmt, CASE WHEN SUM(l.QTY) > 0 THEN SUM(ISNULL(l.AMT, l.QTY * ISNULL(l.UNIT_PRICE,0))) / SUM(l.QTY) ELSE 0 END AS avgInPrice FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER l LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.PROD_CD, p.PROD_NM FROM TBL_PROD_MST p WHERE p.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND p.PROD_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(p2.PROD_SEQ) FROM TBL_PROD_MST p2 WHERE p2.PROD_CD = p.PROD_CD AND p2.ACTION_YN = 'Y') ) pm ON pm.PROD_CD = l.PROD_CD WHERE l.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND l.IO_GB = 'I' AND ( ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND ISNULL(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND l.TRX_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) OR ( ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR ISNULL(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' ) AND LEFT(l.TRX_DT,6) = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{ym,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','') ) ) GROUP BY l.PROD_SEQ, l.PROD_CD, ISNULL(l.VENDOR_CD,'') ORDER BY ISNULL(l.VENDOR_CD,''), l.PROD_CD

mapper.select: SELECT SALEPRICE_SEQ AS salepriceSeq, PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, PROD_CD AS prodCd, VENDOR_CD AS vendorCd, VENDOR_NM AS vendorNm, APPLY_DT AS applyDt, SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, WHOLE_PRICE AS wholePrice, BASE_INPRICE AS baseInprice, MARGIN_RT AS marginRt, PREV_PRICE AS prevPrice, REMARK AS remark, REG_DTTM AS regDttm, REG_USER AS regUser FROM TBL_PROD_SALEPRICE_HST WHERE PROD_SEQ = #{prodSeq} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY APPLY_DT DESC, SALEPRICE_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_PROD_SALEPRICE_HST (PROD_SEQ, PROD_CD, VENDOR_CD, VENDOR_NM, APPLY_DT, SALE_PRICE, WHOLE_PRICE, BASE_INPRICE, MARGIN_RT, PREV_PRICE, REMARK, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) VALUES (#{prodSeq}, #{prodCd,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{vendorCd,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{vendorNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, REPLACE(ISNULL(#{applyDt,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},''),'-',''), #{salePrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{wholePrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, ISNULL(#{baseInprice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, (SELECT IN_PRICE FROM TBL_PROD_MST WHERE PROD_SEQ = #{prodSeq})), #{marginRt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, (SELECT SALE_PRICE FROM TBL_PROD_MST WHERE PROD_SEQ = #{prodSeq}), #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=NVARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT l.LEDGER_SEQ AS ledgerSeq, l.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, l.PROD_CD AS prodCd, l.TRX_DT AS trxDt, l.IO_GB AS ioGb, l.QTY AS qty, l.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, l.AMT AS amt, l.BAL_QTY AS balQty, l.VENDOR_CD AS vendorCd, /* 사업장: SHIPOUT 자동연동 행은 BIZ_CD 가 NULL → 출고원본(TBL_SHIPOUT_MST)에서 같은 품목·출고일자의 사업장명을 모아 표시 (여러 곳이면 콤마 구분) */ CASE WHEN l.REF_GB = 'SHIPOUT' THEN ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + s.BIZ_NM FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND s.ITEM_CD = l.PROD_CD AND s.SHPOUT_DT = l.REF_NO AND ISNULL(s.BIZ_NM,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0) > 0 FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.','NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, ''), l.BIZ_CD) ELSE l.BIZ_CD END AS bizCd, l.REF_GB AS refGb, l.REF_NO AS refNo, l.REMARK AS remark, l.REG_DTTM AS regDttm, l.REG_USER AS regUser FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER l WHERE l.PROD_SEQ = #{prodSeq} AND l.ACTION_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY l.TRX_DT DESC, l.LEDGER_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_STOCK_LEDGER (PROD_SEQ, PROD_CD, TRX_DT, IO_GB, QTY, UNIT_PRICE, AMT, VENDOR_CD, BIZ_CD, REF_GB, REF_NO, REMARK, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) VALUES (#{prodSeq}, #{prodCd,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},''),'-',''), #{ioGb,jdbcType=NCHAR}, #{qty,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{unitPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, ISNULL(#{amt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{qty,jdbcType=INTEGER} * ISNULL(#{unitPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL},0)), #{vendorCd,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{bizCd,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{refGb,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{refNo,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=NVARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT STOCK_SEQ AS stockSeq, PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, PROD_CD AS prodCd, CUR_QTY AS curQty, AVG_IN_PRICE AS avgInPrice, LAST_INPRICE AS lastInprice, LAST_SALEPRICE AS lastSaleprice, STOCK_AMT AS stockAmt, LAST_IN_DT AS lastInDt, LAST_OUT_DT AS lastOutDt FROM TBL_STOCK_MST WHERE PROD_SEQ = #{prodSeq} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y'

SELECT l.LEDGER_SEQ AS ledgerSeq, l.PROD_CD AS prodCd, p.PROD_NM AS prodNm, l.TRX_DT AS trxDt, l.VENDOR_CD AS vendorCd, l.QTY AS qty, l.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, l.AMT AS amt, l.REMARK AS remark, l.REG_DTTM AS regDttm FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER l LEFT JOIN TBL_PROD_MST p ON p.PROD_SEQ = l.PROD_SEQ WHERE l.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND l.IO_GB = 'I'
AND l.TRX_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{fromDt},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{toDt},'-','')
AND ( l.PROD_CD LIKE '%' + #{findData} + '%' OR ISNULL(p.PROD_NM,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData} + '%' OR ISNULL(l.VENDOR_CD,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData} + '%' )
ORDER BY l.TRX_DT DESC, l.LEDGER_SEQ DESC

SELECT l.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, l.PROD_CD AS prodCd, ISNULL(p.PROD_NM,'') AS prodNm, SUM(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB IN ('I','R','A') THEN l.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS inQty, SUM(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB = 'O' THEN l.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS outQty, SUM(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB IN ('I','R','A') THEN l.QTY WHEN l.IO_GB='O' THEN -l.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS curQty, MAX(m.AVG_IN_PRICE) AS avgInPrice, MAX(m.LAST_INPRICE) AS lastInprice, MAX(m.LAST_SALEPRICE) AS lastSaleprice, SUM(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB IN ('I','R','A') THEN l.QTY WHEN l.IO_GB='O' THEN -l.QTY ELSE 0 END) * ISNULL(MAX(m.AVG_IN_PRICE),0) AS stockAmt, MAX(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB='I' THEN l.TRX_DT END) AS lastInDt, MAX(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB='O' THEN l.TRX_DT END) AS lastOutDt FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER l LEFT JOIN TBL_STOCK_MST m ON m.PROD_SEQ = l.PROD_SEQ LEFT JOIN TBL_PROD_MST p ON p.PROD_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(p2.PROD_SEQ) FROM TBL_PROD_MST p2 WHERE p2.PROD_CD = l.PROD_CD AND p2.ACTION_YN='Y') WHERE l.ACTION_YN = 'Y'
AND l.TRX_DT <= REPLACE(#{asOfDt},'-','')
AND ( l.PROD_CD LIKE '%' + #{findData} + '%' OR ISNULL(p.PROD_NM,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData} + '%' )
GROUP BY l.PROD_SEQ, l.PROD_CD, p.PROD_NM ORDER BY l.PROD_CD
SELECT DISTINCT SHPOUT_DT FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST WHERE ACTION_YN='Y' AND ISNULL(SHPOUT_DT,'') <> '' ORDER BY SHPOUT_DT
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER WHERE REF_GB = 'SHIPOUT' AND REF_NO = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt},''),'-','')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_STOCK_LEDGER (PROD_SEQ, PROD_CD, TRX_DT, IO_GB, QTY, UNIT_PRICE, AMT, BIZ_CD, REF_GB, REF_NO, REMARK, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) SELECT pm.PROD_SEQ, s.ITEM_CD, s.SHPOUT_DT, 'O', SUM(ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0)) AS QTY, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'SHIPOUT', s.SHPOUT_DT, N'출고 자동연동(SHIPOUT)', 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19),GETDATE(),120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s JOIN ( SELECT PROD_CD, MAX(PROD_SEQ) AS PROD_SEQ FROM TBL_PROD_MST WHERE ACTION_YN='Y' GROUP BY PROD_CD ) pm ON pm.PROD_CD = s.ITEM_CD WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(s.ITEM_CD,'') <> '' AND s.SHPOUT_DT = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt},''),'-','') GROUP BY pm.PROD_SEQ, s.ITEM_CD, s.SHPOUT_DT HAVING SUM(ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0)) > 0
mapper.update: MERGE TBL_STOCK_MST AS t USING ( SELECT PROD_SEQ, MAX(PROD_CD) AS PROD_CD, SUM(CASE WHEN IO_GB IN ('I','R') THEN QTY WHEN IO_GB='O' THEN -QTY WHEN IO_GB='A' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS CUR_QTY, SUM(CASE WHEN IO_GB='I' THEN QTY*ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE,0) ELSE 0 END) AS IN_AMT, SUM(CASE WHEN IO_GB='I' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS IN_QTY, MAX(CASE WHEN IO_GB='I' THEN TRX_DT END) AS LAST_IN_DT, MAX(CASE WHEN IO_GB='O' THEN TRX_DT END) AS LAST_OUT_DT FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER WHERE ACTION_YN='Y' GROUP BY PROD_SEQ ) AS s ON (t.PROD_SEQ = s.PROD_SEQ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.CUR_QTY = ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0), t.AVG_IN_PRICE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.IN_QTY,0)=0 THEN t.AVG_IN_PRICE ELSE s.IN_AMT/s.IN_QTY END, t.STOCK_AMT = ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0) * CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.IN_QTY,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(t.AVG_IN_PRICE,0) ELSE s.IN_AMT/s.IN_QTY END, t.LAST_IN_DT = s.LAST_IN_DT, t.LAST_OUT_DT = s.LAST_OUT_DT, t.UPD_DTTM = CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), t.UPD_USER=#{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, t.UPD_IP=#{regIp,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PROD_SEQ, PROD_CD, CUR_QTY, AVG_IN_PRICE, STOCK_AMT, LAST_IN_DT, LAST_OUT_DT, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) VALUES (s.PROD_SEQ, s.PROD_CD, ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0), CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.IN_QTY,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE s.IN_AMT/s.IN_QTY END, ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0) * CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.IN_QTY,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE s.IN_AMT/s.IN_QTY END, s.LAST_IN_DT, s.LAST_OUT_DT, 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=NVARCHAR});

MERGE TBL_STOCK_MST AS t USING ( SELECT #{prodSeq} AS PROD_SEQ, SUM(CASE WHEN IO_GB IN ('I','R') THEN QTY WHEN IO_GB='O' THEN -QTY WHEN IO_GB='A' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS CUR_QTY, SUM(CASE WHEN IO_GB='I' THEN QTY*ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE,0) ELSE 0 END) AS IN_AMT, SUM(CASE WHEN IO_GB='I' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS IN_QTY, MAX(CASE WHEN IO_GB='I' THEN TRX_DT END) AS LAST_IN_DT, MAX(CASE WHEN IO_GB='O' THEN TRX_DT END) AS LAST_OUT_DT FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER WHERE PROD_SEQ = #{prodSeq} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y' ) AS s ON (t.PROD_SEQ = s.PROD_SEQ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.CUR_QTY = ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0), t.AVG_IN_PRICE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.IN_QTY,0)=0 THEN t.AVG_IN_PRICE ELSE s.IN_AMT/s.IN_QTY END, t.LAST_INPRICE = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 UNIT_PRICE FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER WHERE PROD_SEQ=#{prodSeq} AND ACTION_YN='Y' AND IO_GB='I' ORDER BY TRX_DT DESC, LEDGER_SEQ DESC), t.LAST_INPRICE), t.LAST_SALEPRICE = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 UNIT_PRICE FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER WHERE PROD_SEQ=#{prodSeq} AND ACTION_YN='Y' AND IO_GB='O' ORDER BY TRX_DT DESC, LEDGER_SEQ DESC), t.LAST_SALEPRICE), t.STOCK_AMT = ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0) * CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.IN_QTY,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(t.AVG_IN_PRICE,0) ELSE s.IN_AMT/s.IN_QTY END, t.LAST_IN_DT = s.LAST_IN_DT, t.LAST_OUT_DT = s.LAST_OUT_DT, t.UPD_DTTM = CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), t.UPD_USER=#{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, t.UPD_IP=#{regIp,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PROD_SEQ, PROD_CD, CUR_QTY, AVG_IN_PRICE, LAST_INPRICE, LAST_SALEPRICE, STOCK_AMT, LAST_IN_DT, LAST_OUT_DT, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) VALUES (#{prodSeq}, COALESCE(#{prodCd,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, (SELECT TOP 1 PROD_CD FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER WHERE PROD_SEQ=#{prodSeq})), ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0), CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.IN_QTY,0)=0 THEN NULL ELSE s.IN_AMT/s.IN_QTY END, (SELECT TOP 1 UNIT_PRICE FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER WHERE PROD_SEQ=#{prodSeq} AND ACTION_YN='Y' AND IO_GB='I' ORDER BY TRX_DT DESC, LEDGER_SEQ DESC), (SELECT TOP 1 UNIT_PRICE FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER WHERE PROD_SEQ=#{prodSeq} AND ACTION_YN='Y' AND IO_GB='O' ORDER BY TRX_DT DESC, LEDGER_SEQ DESC), ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0) * CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.IN_QTY,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE s.IN_AMT/s.IN_QTY END, s.LAST_IN_DT, s.LAST_OUT_DT, 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=NVARCHAR});
mapper.select: SELECT m.PURCH_SEQ AS purchSeq, m.PURCH_DT AS purchDt, m.PURCH_NO AS purchNo, m.VENDOR_CD AS vendorCd, m.VENDOR_NM AS vendorNm, m.MGR_CD AS mgrCd, m.MGR_NM AS mgrNm, m.WH_CD AS whCd, m.WH_NM AS whNm, m.TOT_BOX_QTY AS totBoxQty, m.TOT_EA_QTY AS totEaQty, m.TOT_QTY AS totQty, m.SUPPLY_AMT AS supplyAmt, m.VAT_AMT AS vatAmt, m.TOT_AMT AS totAmt, m.DC_AMT AS dcAmt, m.PAY_GB AS payGb, m.PAY_AMT AS payAmt, m.REMARK AS remark, m.REG_DTTM AS regDttm, m.REG_USER AS regUser, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_PURCHASE_DTL d WHERE d.PURCH_SEQ = m.PURCH_SEQ AND d.ACTION_YN='Y') AS prodCnt FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.PURCH_DT >= REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.PURCH_DT <= REPLACE(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{vendorCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.VENDOR_CD = #{vendorCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.MGR_CD = #{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},'') = '' OR ISNULL(m.VENDOR_NM,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' ) ORDER BY m.PURCH_DT DESC, m.PURCH_NO DESC, m.PURCH_SEQ DESC

SELECT d.DTL_SEQ AS dtlSeq, d.PURCH_SEQ AS purchSeq, d.ROW_NO AS rowNo, d.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, d.PROD_CD AS prodCd, d.PROD_NM AS prodNm, d.SPEC AS spec, d.PACK_QTY AS packQty, d.BOX_QTY AS boxQty, d.EA_QTY AS eaQty, d.QTY AS qty, d.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, d.AMT AS amt, d.DC_AMT AS dcAmt, d.SUPPLY_AMT AS supplyAmt, d.VAT_AMT AS vatAmt, d.TOT_AMT AS totAmt, d.SERVICE_QTY AS serviceQty, d.REMARK AS remark, d.EVENT_YN AS eventYn, d.TRX_GB AS trxGb, d.LEDGER_SEQ AS ledgerSeq FROM TBL_PURCHASE_DTL d WHERE d.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND d.PURCH_SEQ = #{purchSeq} ORDER BY d.ROW_NO
SELECT RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(MAX(CAST(PURCH_NO AS INT)),0) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 4) FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND PURCH_DT = REPLACE(#{purchDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_PURCHASE_MST (PURCH_DT, PURCH_NO, VENDOR_CD, VENDOR_NM, MGR_CD, MGR_NM, WH_CD, WH_NM, TOT_BOX_QTY, TOT_EA_QTY, TOT_QTY, SUPPLY_AMT, VAT_AMT, TOT_AMT, DC_AMT, PAY_GB, PAY_AMT, REMARK, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) VALUES (REPLACE(ISNULL(#{purchDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-',''), #{purchNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vendorCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vendorNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mgrNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{whCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{whNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{totBoxQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{totEaQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{totQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{supplyAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{vatAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{totAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{dcAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{payGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_PURCHASE_MST SET PURCH_DT = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{purchDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-',''), VENDOR_CD = #{vendorCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VENDOR_NM = #{vendorNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, MGR_CD = #{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MGR_NM = #{mgrNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, WH_CD = #{whCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WH_NM = #{whNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, TOT_BOX_QTY = #{totBoxQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, TOT_EA_QTY = #{totEaQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, TOT_QTY = #{totQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, SUPPLY_AMT = #{supplyAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, VAT_AMT = #{vatAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, TOT_AMT = #{totAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, DC_AMT = #{dcAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, PAY_GB = #{payGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PAY_AMT = #{payAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, REMARK = #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, UPD_DTTM = CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), UPD_USER = #{updUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, UPD_IP = #{updIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE PURCH_SEQ = #{purchSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_PURCHASE_DTL (PURCH_SEQ, ROW_NO, PROD_SEQ, PROD_CD, PROD_NM, SPEC, PACK_QTY, BOX_QTY, EA_QTY, QTY, UNIT_PRICE, AMT, DC_AMT, SUPPLY_AMT, VAT_AMT, TOT_AMT, SERVICE_QTY, REMARK, EVENT_YN, TRX_GB, LEDGER_SEQ, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) VALUES (#{purchSeq}, #{rowNo}, #{prodSeq,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{prodCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prodNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{spec,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{packQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{boxQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{eaQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{qty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{unitPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{amt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{dcAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{supplyAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{vatAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{totAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{serviceQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{eventYn,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{trxGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ledgerSeq,jdbcType=INTEGER}, 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 d.UNIT_PRICE FROM TBL_PURCHASE_DTL d JOIN TBL_PURCHASE_MST m ON m.PURCH_SEQ = d.PURCH_SEQ AND m.ACTION_YN='Y' WHERE d.ACTION_YN='Y' AND d.PROD_CD = #{prodCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.VENDOR_CD = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ORDER BY m.PURCH_DT DESC, m.PURCH_NO DESC

SELECT m.PURCH_DT AS spec, -- 거래일자 (화면 표시용으로 spec 칸 재사용) m.VENDOR_NM AS prodNm, -- 거래처 d.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, d.BOX_QTY AS boxQty, d.EA_QTY AS eaQty, d.QTY AS qty, d.AMT AS amt, d.EVENT_YN AS eventYn, d.TRX_GB AS trxGb FROM TBL_PURCHASE_DTL d JOIN TBL_PURCHASE_MST m ON m.PURCH_SEQ = d.PURCH_SEQ AND m.ACTION_YN='Y' WHERE d.ACTION_YN='Y' AND d.PROD_CD = #{prodCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.VENDOR_CD = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND m.PURCH_DT >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR,-3,GETDATE()), 112) -- 최대 3년 ORDER BY m.PURCH_DT DESC, m.PURCH_NO DESC

SELECT x.dt AS dt, SUM(x.purchAmt) AS purchAmt, SUM(x.dcAmt) AS dcAmt, SUM(x.payAmt) AS payAmt, SUM(x.discAmt) AS discAmt FROM ( SELECT m.PURCH_DT AS dt, ISNULL(m.TOT_AMT,0) AS purchAmt, 0 AS dcAmt, ISNULL(m.PAY_AMT,0) AS payAmt, ISNULL(m.DC_AMT,0) AS discAmt FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND m.VENDOR_CD = #{vendorCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION ALL SELECT t.TRX_DT AS dt, 0 AS purchAmt, 0 AS dcAmt, ISNULL(t.AMT,0) AS payAmt, ISNULL(t.DC_AMT,0) AS discAmt FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX t WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND t.TRX_GB = 'PAY' AND t.CUST_CD = #{vendorCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) x GROUP BY x.dt ORDER BY x.dt

SELECT t.TRX_SEQ AS trxSeq, t.TRX_GB AS trxGb, t.TRX_DT AS trxDt, t.TRX_NO AS trxNo, t.PAY_GB AS payGb, t.ACCT_CD AS acctCd, t.ACCT_NM AS acctNm, t.CUST_CD AS custCd, t.CUST_NM AS custNm, t.MGR_CD AS mgrCd, t.MGR_NM AS mgrNm, t.AMT AS amt, t.DC_AMT AS dcAmt, t.SALE_DC_AMT AS saleDcAmt, t.TOT_AMT AS totAmt, t.REMARK AS remark, t.REG_DTTM AS regDttm, t.REG_USER AS regUser FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX t WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND t.TRX_GB = #{trxGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.TRX_DT >= REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.TRX_DT <= REPLACE(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{payGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.PAY_GB = #{payGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.MGR_CD = #{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},'') = '' OR ISNULL(t.CUST_NM,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' ) ORDER BY t.TRX_DT DESC, t.TRX_NO DESC, t.TRX_SEQ DESC

SELECT RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(MAX(CAST(TRX_NO AS INT)),0) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 4) FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND TRX_GB = #{trxGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRX_DT = REPLACE(#{trxDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_SETTLE_TRX (TRX_GB, TRX_DT, TRX_NO, PAY_GB, ACCT_CD, ACCT_NM, CUST_CD, CUST_NM, MGR_CD, MGR_NM, AMT, DC_AMT, SALE_DC_AMT, TOT_AMT, REMARK, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) VALUES (#{trxGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-',''), #{trxNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{acctCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{acctNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{custNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mgrNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{amt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{dcAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{saleDcAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{totAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_SETTLE_TRX SET TRX_DT = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-',''), PAY_GB = #{payGb,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ACCT_CD = #{acctCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ACCT_NM = #{acctNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CUST_NM = #{custNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, MGR_CD = #{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MGR_NM = #{mgrNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, AMT = #{amt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, DC_AMT = #{dcAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, SALE_DC_AMT = #{saleDcAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, TOT_AMT = #{totAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, REMARK = #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, UPD_DTTM = CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), UPD_USER = #{updUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, UPD_IP = #{updIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE TRX_SEQ = #{trxSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT x.dt AS dt, SUM(x.saleAmt) AS saleAmt, SUM(x.dcAmt) AS dcAmt, SUM(x.rcvAmt) AS rcvAmt, SUM(x.purchAmt) AS purchAmt, SUM(x.payAmt) AS payAmt, SUM(x.discAmt) AS discAmt FROM ( SELECT ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) AS dt, ISNULL(s.SALE_AMT,0) AS saleAmt, 0 AS dcAmt, 0 AS rcvAmt, 0 AS purchAmt, 0 AS payAmt, 0 AS discAmt FROM TBL_SALES_MST s WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) IS NOT NULL AND s.DC_CD = ( SELECT MAX(v.DC_CD) FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST v WHERE v.VENDOR_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND v.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(v.DC_CD,'') <> '' ) UNION ALL SELECT m.PURCH_DT AS dt, 0 AS saleAmt, 0 AS dcAmt, 0 AS rcvAmt, ISNULL(m.TOT_AMT,0) AS purchAmt, ISNULL(m.PAY_AMT,0) AS payAmt, ISNULL(m.DC_AMT,0) AS discAmt FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND m.VENDOR_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION ALL SELECT t.TRX_DT, 0, ISNULL(t.SALE_DC_AMT,0), CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB='RCV' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, 0, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB='PAY' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, ISNULL(t.DC_AMT,0) FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX t WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND t.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) x GROUP BY x.dt ORDER BY x.dt
